final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(average_price) AS average_price FROM media_averages) SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.average_price, m.average_price / NULLIF(b.average_price, 0) AS ratio FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN baseline AS b ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
